newsitem.title: USA: US debt futures end lackluster day narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: US debt futures end lackluster day narrowly mixed.

text.p: U.S. debt futures finished a lackluster session narrowly mixed after T-bonds traded fractionally higher and Eurodollars edged slightly lower.
June T-bonds traded inside Friday's ranges, with the bulk of the day's trades occurring between 106-20/32 and 106-22/32, traders said.
September Eurodollars continued to grind lower in the afternoon, easing towards a trendline level of 93.625.
"We seem to be looking for bearish numbers," one futures trader said about the U.S. March Consumer Price Index which will be released on Tuesday at 0830 EDT/1230 GMT.
Traders on average are looking for overall CPI to rise 0.2 percent and core CPI to increase 0.3 percent.
They said the key inflation report was contributing to the light flow that has recently marked Mondays.
"Mondays in general have been quiet the last couple of weeks," one T-bond futures trader said.
While some portfolio managers have been describing the U.S. bond market as fairly valued, he has seen little evidence that they have been participating in the market.
"They have been talking as though a yield of 7.15-7.20 percent is where you start to see value," he said.
